description: This PHP file defines a class 'Screen' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Util\V1\Dto'. It models a screen component for the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating properties such as name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator. The class includes a constructor for initializing these properties, a static factory method 'createFromArray' to instantiate from an array, and getter methods for each property.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Represents a UI screen in the OrangeHRM system with properties such as name, module, URL, permissions, and an optional menu configurator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Screen object with specified name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a Screen instance from a given name and data array, transforming permission data using DataGroupPermission::createFromArray.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the screen.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator associated with the screen, if any.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions associated with the screen.
